text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That GⅡ race the other day was amazing!
Orfevre! It really felt like perfection!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! I wonder if we'll get to see it this year—
the moment a Triple Crown Umamusume is born!
The Satsuki Sho, held under such circumstances—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Ghh, HAAAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(A searing fighting spirit.
A tension so sharp it makes me tremble.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Haughty dreams, arrogant words. And yet, those eyes pursuing that dream are so innocent and pure.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Just by being on the turf.
Just by dashing through it.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (The spotlight belongs to her—!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: 1st place, Orfevvvre!!!
(WOOOOOOO...!)

The Satsuki Sho where Orfevre claimed victory.
News of her sheer ferocity spread in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Man, Orfevre!
I just watched an incredible race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the Japan Derby.
She'll definitely deliver next time too!

text_block_list.name: Umatter
text_block_list.text: “I was watching from the stands, and Orfevre's aura was seriously built different. She was already winning by a landslide just with her aura.”

text_block_list.name: Umatter
text_block_list.text:
"The Satsuki Sho was so fun!
I'm so hyped for Orfevre's future now.
Anyone wanna go to the Derby with me?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...Amazing. Everyone is talking about "Orfevre"—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Ah... just as I thought. She's――)

The day after the Satsuki Sho. Before training began,
she came to visit me with a formal demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ever since yesterday, everywhere you go,
everyone's talking non-stop about Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
At first, I thought it was just because I won, but...
no, that's probably not it.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if she had lost,
I think people would still be talking about her just as much."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"People say things like, ‘Can't wait for her next race’ or ‘Her aura is incredible.’
There are just so many fans enjoying her racing career right alongside her."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: The sheer grandeur of her dream, and her star power as she strives to achieve it, captivated the eyes of everyone—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "Regardless of the outcome, you can't help but keep your eyes on Orfevre."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what kind of expression she's making right now.
I wonder what she's feeling right now.
I wonder how she'll take her next step forward."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it really gets my heart racing, you know?

When we decided to head for the Aoba Sho,
I was worried others might steal the spotlight even if we won, but—
It seemed those concerns were right on the mark.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still, that doesn't tell me
what I'm actually supposed to do, though.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Do I just need to run a race they can call unprecedented...?
A race flashy enough to be talked about for years to come—is that what it takes?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Still, ah, either way,
I can't do anything unless I win first...
choice_data_list: Then... what we should do right now is obviously...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right.
Getting stronger is an absolute must."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Build up enough strength to keep on winning, and challenge her.
Then, maybe, eventually—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"If only I could see something...
I really hope that happens."
"In any case, let's keep moving forward for now. And so, the days of training began once more."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Alright then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah--

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...I already knew it, but
facing her like this really drives it home...
She truly is special...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...A natural-born star.
A born, genius-level charisma.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...There's no way...
There's no way I can surpass something like that.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (..."Impossible"...?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...No, w-what am I thinking, idiot!
Thinking so weakly won't get me anywhere—!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(If that's the case, then that's it!
I'll let my feelings swell and scream them out...! Just like always!)

Suddenly, her speed plummeted.
Did something go wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...! Haah, haah!
I-I'm sorry... Yelling a bit just now――

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Wait. Is it really okay for me to tell them?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Just now... just as I was about to scream out my fear that it's impossible, all the strength drained from my body...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Is it okay for me to say
that I thought it was impossible?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I-I overthought what to shout a bit, and...
I guess I kinda spun my wheels—

...She wore a somewhat uncomfortable expression.
Perhaps she didn't want to explain why.
choice_data_list: (...Is that something she doesn't want to be asked about?)

text_block_list.text:
At any rate, if she's dodging the question this much,
it wouldn't be right to force it out of her.
From the looks of it, she doesn't seem to be injured.
choice_data_list: Got it. If anything comes up, just tell me anytime.
Got it. If anything comes up, just let me know anytime, okay?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

"I felt a little lonely that she didn't open up to me,
but... it can't be helped."
choice_data_list: (At least I should do my job properly and be supportive.)

text_block_list.text:
"I want to support her as best I can
from my position as her Trainer."

The next morning. Shifting my mindset, I decided to create
a regimen that would benefit our future training
and set meticulous goals.
While running around trying to fine-tune the load through practical trial—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainer-san...!?
What's wrong? You're sweating so much...
choice_data_list: I need it to make the training menu...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
For making a menu?

I nod, hand over the work-in-progress menu,
and point to where I want the numbers filled in.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...All that just to figure out
some tiny numbers here...?
choice_data_list: I was thinking, if I'm ever going to beat Orfevre someday...

text_block_list.text:
"Let's grow step by step and grab victory
in the Aoba Sho first."
I told her that, wishing to offer some encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, umm...! 
It's just—I-I'm just so happy...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Right. Trainer is looking forward
and giving it their absolute all.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...This is no time to whine
about things being impossible.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(If anything... if I want to move forward,
I have to ignore my weakness and wipe it away!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...!
All right, I'm all fired up!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I want to be just like you, Trainer!
I'm gonna work harder and harder, with everything I've got!

And so, resetting our mindset, our days of sprinting
toward the Aoba Sho began.
